info.name: SaccoSphere API
info.description:
SaccoSphere API Collection - v1.0.0

Base URL: http://localhost:8000

Authentication: JWT Bearer Token

base_url is the active variable every request uses. base_url_local (http://localhost:8000) and base_url_railway (fill in with your deployed Railway web service domain - not committed here, no railway.json/custom-domain config was found in-repo to source a default from) are provided as copy-paste presets: set base_url to whichever one you are targeting.

Never fire mutating requests (disbursement, STK push, erasure, anything irreversible or touching real PII) at a Railway/production base_url - use sandbox credentials against a local instance only.

Google Sign-In + Sign-Up callback. GoogleAuthSerializer takes id_token (Google ID token, NOT an OAuth 'code') + flow (login|signup, default login) + optional nonce. 200 login success / existing linked user; 201 new user created via signup flow; 400 bad token/serializer; 401 verification failed/nonce invalid/email not verified; 404 login flow, no account for that email; 409 a password-only account already exists with that email.

Attach a Google identity to the CURRENT authenticated account (distinct from the public login/signup callback above). Body: id_token + optional nonce. The token's email must match the logged-in user's email. 200 linked; 400 bad token/email mismatch; 401 verification failed; 409 that Google identity is already linked to a different user.

Send OTP code to user's phone number
Verify OTP code and update user's phone number
Resend OTP code (with cooldown period)
Step 1 of 3. Body: phone_number only. Always returns 200 with a generic message regardless of whether the phone exists (anti-enumeration) - never reveals success/failure of delivery.

Step 2 of 3. Body: phone_number + the 6-digit OTP code (verifies purpose=PASSWORD_RESET) - it does NOT take a new password here. On success returns {"reset_token": "<uuid>"}, valid for 15 minutes, which step 3 (password/reset/complete/) needs.
Step 3 of 3. Body: reset_token (from step 2's response) + new_password + new_password2. 200 success; 400 if passwords mismatch/weak, reset_token expired (>15 min), already used, or invalid.

Record the user's consent. consent_type must be one of TERMS | PRIVACY | DATA_PROCESSING | MARKETING (UserConsent.ConsentType). version must start with 'v' (e.g. v1.0). 200 idempotent if an identical active consent already exists; 201 new consent recorded; 400 invalid consent_type/version or a protected field (user/ip_address/timestamp/user_agent) was sent; 429 throttled (10/hr/user, 20/hr/IP).

One entry per ConsentType (4 total) showing the user's CURRENT status for each - either the most recent real consent record, or a 'never_given' placeholder. Distinct from /consents/history/ which returns the full audit trail.
Full chronological list of every consent record for this user (including withdrawn/superseded ones), newest first.

Downloadable export of the user's own consents + DataConsentLog entries where they were the data subject. Uses non-standard pagination param names (consents_page/consents_page_size, logs_page/logs_page_size), not the usual page/page_size. Throttled 5/hr/user, 10/hr/IP.

consent_type is a PATH parameter (TERMS|PRIVACY|DATA_PROCESSING|MARKETING), no request body needed. 200 the now-withdrawn record; 400 invalid consent_type; 404 no active consent of that type to withdraw.

Member-initiated DPA data-erasure request. Body: reason. 201 created (status=PENDING) if no compliance hold applies; 202 created (status=ON_HOLD) if a KYC/regulatory hold applies - response includes hold_reason/hold_until; 400 if the user already has a PENDING request.

STAFF ONLY (checks request.user.is_staff directly, not a SACCO-admin role). Body: action (approve|reject) + optional reviewer_notes. approve immediately anonymizes the user + KYC record and revokes all outstanding JWTs. 200 success; 400 invalid action, or the request was already reviewed (status != PENDING); 403 caller is not staff; 404 unknown request_id.

PUBLIC link (no auth) for a member to report a missing/incorrect disbursement. POST with token+reason in the JSON body (same token-in-body reasoning as confirm-disbursement above, NOT a GET). 200 on success or idempotent re-dispute; 400 missing/expired/bad token, or already MEMBER_CONFIRMED/AUTO_CONFIRMED.

Receive a generic PSP callback payload. [DEPRECATED - ALWAYS RETURNS 410] This view does no real work; it always returns HTTP 410 Gone pointing callers at its replacement. Kept here so the deprecation is documented rather than silently dropped from the collection. Replacement: the tokenized M-Pesa-specific callback URLs above.

Initiate a PSP-backed savings withdrawal. [DEPRECATED - ALWAYS RETURNS 410] This view does no real work; it always returns HTTP 410 Gone pointing callers at its replacement. Kept here so the deprecation is documented rather than silently dropped from the collection. Replacement is actually /api/v1/payments/mpesa/b2c/withdraw/ (SavingsWithdrawalView, added below as 'Savings Withdrawal (B2C)') - note the 410 response body's own 'alternative' field points at /mpesa/b2c/disburse/, which is the LOAN disbursement endpoint, not a savings withdrawal endpoint; that looks like a stale message in the code itself.

The REAL, functioning member-initiated savings withdrawal (SavingsWithdrawalView) - distinct from the deprecated 410 stub at /withdrawal/ above. Member-facing (IsAuthenticated only, no admin role) - ownership/status checks happen server-side. amount must be >0 and <= 250,000.00 (MAX_B2C_WITHDRAWAL_AMOUNT), net of fee must be >0. idempotency_key is optional client-supplied dedup token. 201 initiated; 200 duplicate/idempotent match; 202 Daraja timeout (balance stays reserved, PENDING_CONFIRMATION); 502 hard Daraja error (balance auto-reversed); 400 validation (over ceiling, account not ACTIVE, insufficient balance, wrong owner/sacco, unapproved membership).

Initiate a PSP-backed member deposit. [DEPRECATED - ALWAYS RETURNS 410] This view does no real work; it always returns HTTP 410 Gone pointing callers at its replacement. Kept here so the deprecation is documented rather than silently dropped from the collection. Replacement: /api/v1/payments/mpesa/stk-push/ (STKPushView, already covered by 'Initiate STK Push' below).

SUPER ADMIN ONLY (IsSuperAdmin, not IsSaccoAdmin - not SACCO-scoped by header, loan_id resolves the sacco). Disburses to a phone number OTHER than the member's own registered number (e.g. lost SIM) - requires a written reason (>=10 chars). amount must exactly equal loan.amount. Writes two DisbursementAuditLog rows (B2C_INITIATED + B2C_ALTERNATE_NUMBER_AUTHORIZED). 201 initiated; 202 Daraja timeout/ambiguous; 502 hard Daraja error; 409 disbursement already in progress/done; 400 validation (loan not APPROVED, amount mismatch, pending guarantors, etc); 403 not super admin; 404 loan not found.

  "loan_id": "{{loan_id}}",
  "phone_number": "+254712345678",

  "remarks": "Loan Disbursement",
  "reason": "Member reports lost SIM card, verified via ID + alternate contact"
}

Kept here so the deprecation is documented rather than silently dropped from the collection. Replacement: the tokenized M-Pesa-specific callback URLs above.

PUBLIC Daraja-facing callback (authentication_classes=[]) - the real gate is (1) callback_token as a PATH segment matching the single app-wide MPESA_CALLBACK_TOKEN setting, checked with hmac.compare_digest, (2) Safaricom IP allowlist, (3) an HMAC signature check. Set the {{mpesa_callback_token}} collection variable to match your target deployment's MPESA_CALLBACK_TOKEN env var. Always returns 200 {ResultCode:0} once persisted, REGARDLESS of the underlying M-Pesa result (Daraja convention) - 403 only for token/IP/signature failures, 400 for bad JSON, 503 (retryable) if the matching transaction isn't found yet or the broker is down.
PUBLIC Daraja-facing B2C result callback - same token-in-path + IP-allowlist + HMAC-signature gating and 200-always-once-persisted convention as the STK callback above.

PUBLIC link (AllowAny, no auth) an external/non-member guarantor clicks from an SMS. Body: action (ACCEPT|DECLINE, required, uppercase) + notes (optional, <=300 chars). All three 'can't respond' cases share the SAME status code: invalid token, expired token, and already-responded token all return 403 Forbidden (distinguished only by the detail message) - NOT 410 Gone and NOT differentiated 400s.

Upserts by token (update_or_create) - if the token previously belonged to a different user it's reassigned (audit-logged). platform must be one of ANDROID|IOS|WEB (DeviceToken.Platform, UPPERCASE) - note this is a different casing convention than accounts/device/register/'s platform field (ios|android, lowercase) since they're two separate serializers/models. 201 new token; 200 existing token updated/reassigned; 400 missing/invalid platform.
List monthly invoices visible to current SACCO admin or super admin
Retrieve one invoice by ID

MODEL MISMATCH TO BE AWARE OF: this view (MonthlyInvoiceResendView) looks up the MonthlySaccoInvoice model, NOT the Invoice model that backs every other /billing/invoices/... endpoint (list/detail/download/mark-paid). These are two separate id spaces - do NOT reuse {{invoice_id}} captured from the invoice list here; it will 404. Use a MonthlySaccoInvoice id (set as {{monthly_invoice_id}}, a new collection variable added for this reason). 200 sent; 400 no recipients configured; 404 no such MonthlySaccoInvoice.

InvoiceDownloadView takes NO query parameters - it unconditionally streams the invoice PDF at invoice.pdf_path as application/pdf. There is no ?format=csv/pdf switch in this view; a format param would simply be ignored (no-op), so it has been removed here. 200 PDF stream; 404 no such invoice OR pdf_path empty/file missing (JSON body {"detail": "Invoice PDF is not available."}); 403 wrong role or cross-SACCO access.
Preview uninvoiced current-month SACCO billing line items.
Return platform revenue summary for super admins.
Super admin endpoint to record invoice payment and restore SACCO access.

SUPER ADMIN ONLY. Grants or lifts a SACCO's exemption from automatic billing suspension - never set automatically. Body: exempt (bool, required - must be a real JSON boolean, not the string "true") + reason (required, non-blank, ONLY when exempt=true; ignored/cleared when exempt=false). No expiry field exists - exemption is indefinite until reversed with a follow-up exempt:false call. 200 success; 400 exempt missing/not boolean, or missing reason while granting; 404 no such sacco.
Same endpoint as 'Grant SACCO Billing Exemption' - send exempt:false to reverse it. reason is ignored/cleared in this direction.
